certification.scope: Permanent public exhibition shell and automated public-release gates; individual numbered-build release status remains governed by each build lifecycle.

basis.truthfulLifecycle: CanonicalBuild.publicState is the single public lifecycle field: OnView, InLab, ComingNext. Gallery cards and build rooms render from it.
basis.informationArchitecture: Entrance, gallery, build rooms, active A/B artifacts, public record, lineage, practice/contact, and future-room paths are explicitly linked.
basis.publicComprehension: Gallery explains A / THE THING, B / THE STORY and THE RECORD and explicitly says no technical training is required.
basis.visualSystem: Entrance, gallery and build-room public surfaces use the Exhibition Space Arial/sans + mono language; legacy Georgia styling was removed from these public shell surfaces.
basis.responsiveAutomated: Full Playwright certification passed representative gallery widths including 320, 390, 768 and 1280 CSS px, plus narrow entrance, practice, Build 004 and future-room routes and pathological Build 004 user strings.
basis.accessibilityAutomated: Chromium and WebKit certification passed automated accessible-name, keyboard-focus, non-overflow and relevant interaction checks across the public shell and active build surfaces.
basis.metadata: Entrance and gallery have canonical/social metadata; build-room metadata is registry driven; A/B metadata remains build-specific.
basis.navigationErrors: Global not-found route returns visitors to /100-builds/.
basis.conversionPath: /practice/ provides a public LinkedIn contact link and a route back to the exhibition.
basis.futureCycleAutomation: Progress counts, current lab build and entrance status derive from registry lifecycle rather than hard-coded numbers.
basis.releaseEngineering: GitHub Actions run 31917374407 on code head 5a7fecb0cf43e6f78719b7982bd8f269cd1c9dc1 passed lineage validation, typecheck, lint, production build, Chromium/WebKit browser installation and the complete Playwright certification suite.
basis.finalAdversarial: The release pass repaired stale lifecycle assertions, canonical trailing-slash expectations, narrow-screen overflow, Build 004 provenance scoping, verification invariants and Safari textarea state handling, then reran the complete cross-browser suite to green.
basis.manualAcceptanceBoundary: Physical-device, screen-reader, touch/zoom and rendered third-party social-preview inspection are explicitly retained as DEVICE_MANUAL and are not represented as automated PASS.
